summary: Israeli forces conducted airstrikes and burned homes in southern Lebanon while withdrawing from an 11-day operation in Hebron. Iran conducted ballistic missile tests from Isfahan and Hamedan, and a source claims satellite imagery shows destruction at the Supreme Leader's compound in Tehran. UAE oil exports surpassed prewar levels despite Hormuz disruptions.
key_points: Israeli warplanes flew intensively at high altitude over central occupied Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/51399)
Israeli airstrikes hit Aita al-Jabal in southern Lebanon; forces burned homes between Kfar Tibnit and Arnoun. (Source: @redlinkleb/51343, @redlinkleb/51398)
IDF withdrew from Hebron after 11-day operation launched after Oct 23 shooting that killed two soldiers; dozens detained, three firearms captured. (Source: @manniefabian/59462)
Israeli security forces arrested 18 settlers at Givat Ora Yisrael outpost near Salfit after clashes involving roadblocks and weapons seizure. (Source: @manniefabian/59466)
Iran conducted ballistic missile test launches from 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan and from Hamedan province. (Source: @shin_persian/11898, @shin_persian/11888)
A source claims updated satellite imagery shows extensive destruction at Iranian Supreme Leader's compound in Tehran after Operation Epic Fury, alleging Khamenei killed. (Source: @shin_persian/11882)
UAE energy minister reported crude and condensate exports reached 3.94M bpd in June, exceeding prewar levels despite Hormuz disruption. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9336)
EU maritime authorities warn hijacked Iranian fishing vessel AZINI may serve as pirate mothership near international shipping lanes. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9337)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces conducted airstrikes and burned homes in southern Lebanon while withdrawing from an 11-day operation in Hebron. Iran conducted ballistic missile tests from Isfahan and Hamedan, and a source claims satellite imagery shows destruction at the Supreme Leader's compound in Tehran. UAE oil exports surpassed prewar levels despite Hormuz disruptions.

points: Satellite imagery analyzed by a monitoring channel claims extensive destruction at the Iranian Supreme Leader's compound in central Tehran following "Operation Epic Fury," with the source alleging that Ali Khamenei was killed in the opening strikes; arrows on the imagery highlight destruction within the compound and its vicinity. (Source: @shin_persian/11882)

A ballistic missile test launch was detected from the 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan province at 20:40 local time (1710Z), according to a delayed post from an Iranian incident tracking system. (Source: @shin_persian/11898)

Another ballistic missile test launch occurred around Hamedan in Hamedan province at 09:38 local time (0608Z), also reported via the same tracking system with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/11888)

EU maritime authorities warned that the hijacked Iranian fishing vessel AZINI may be used as a mothership for pirate attacks on shipping, noting its recent approach to international shipping lanes. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9337)

A Qatar Amiri Flight Airbus A320 (callsign QAF7, registration A7-AAG) entered Iranian airspace after departing Doha at 16:33 UTC, tracked cruising north over Iran at 21:21 Gulf Time. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9329)
Oil prices fell more than 4% amid prospects of progress in Iran-US negotiations and the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @yediotnews25/137162)
Intensive high-altitude warplane flights were observed over central occupied Palestine, according to a real-time mapping alert. (Source: @redlinkleb/51399)

Israeli Navy exercise scheduled to begin tomorrow morning at Zikim beach, lasting until Wednesday noon, with expected heavy security force movement, vessel activity, and live fire and explosion sounds. (Source: @N12chat/233005)

An IDF military drone crashed near the southern town of Beit Shikma due to a technical malfunction, sparking a fire in an open area with no injuries; investigation ongoing. (Source: @manniefabian/59464)
A UH-60 Black Hawk transport helicopter was tracked heading north over occupied Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/51371)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir stated the IDF has an obligation to be a global leader in AI and robotics, emphasizing integrated human-machine warfare concepts for operational advantage. (Source: @manniefabian/59467)

During an equipment return campaign, the IDF collected over 10,000 items of weapons, ammunition, and military gear on the first day, including an Uzi submachine gun not used for over 30 years; returnees were not questioned. (Source: @yediotnews25/137168)

Israeli forces arrested 18 settlers at the Givat Ora Yisrael outpost near Salfit after rioters set tires ablaze, blocked roads, and clashed with Border Police and Civil Administration troops enforcing demolition orders; incendiary materials, assault weapons, and pepper spray were seized. (Source: @manniefabian/59466)

The IDF withdrew from several Hebron neighborhoods following an 11-day operation launched after the October 23 shooting at a checkpoint that killed Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem; the military demolished illegal structures near the checkpoint and the gunmen's homes, detained dozens, and captured three firearms. (Source: @manniefabian/59462)
Israeli airstrikes targeted Aita al-Jabal in southern Lebanon, per a mapping alert. (Source: @redlinkleb/51343)
Enemy forces burned homes between the towns of Kfar Tibnit and Arnoun in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/51398)
Fire sweeping or artillery fire was reported at Khiam and Haddatha in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/51388)
Israeli warplanes were active in the south of Lebanon on multiple occasions, per mapping alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/51386, @redlinkleb/51365)
The Red Alert Lebanon monthly report for October 2026 was published, though details were not provided in the message. (Source: @redlinkleb/51378)

Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Defense released footage geolocated to coordinates 18.289459, 42.792009 showing an AN/MPQ-50 Pulse Acquisition Radar belonging to an I-HAWK (MIM-23B) air defense system. (Source: @shin_persian/11883)

UAE Energy Minister Suhail Al Mazrouei stated oil exports at times exceed prewar levels despite Hormuz disruption; Kpler data shows crude and condensate exports reached 3.94M bpd in June, up from 2.13M bpd in March, aided by a bypass pipeline. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9336)
Oil prices dropped over 4% on prospects of progress in Iran-US talks and potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @yediotnews25/137162)
A Qatar Amiri Flight VIP transport entered Iranian airspace, tracked north over Iran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9329)

key_developments: Israeli airstrikes hit Aita al-Jabal and forces burned homes between Kfar Tibnit and Arnoun in southern Lebanon, indicating continued cross-border offensive operations. (Source: @redlinkleb/51343, @redlinkleb/51398)
